verifications.claim: National average 30-year FHA mortgage rates are hovering around 5.875% to 6.32% as of April 7, 2026.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'As of April 16, 2026, current 30-Year FHA mortgage rates are 5.875%'; R3: 'national average 30-year FHA mortgage interest rate is 6.31%'; R6: '30-year FHA Rate 5.75%'; R7: '30-year, fixed-rate FHA loan start at 6.305%'
verifications.reasoning: Sources report specific rates within the claimed range around mid-April 2026, supporting the approximate range for national averages, but no source specifies exactly this range as the national average or uses April 7 date.

verifications.claim: Many top lenders offer 30-year fixed options around 6.12%.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R3: lender rates like 4.83%-4.93% interest (APRs ~5.7%), national avg 6.31%; R7: '6.305% (6.356% APR)'
verifications.reasoning: Sources list lender rates and averages near 6.12% (e.g., 6.305%, 6.31%), but no direct mention of 6.12% or top lenders specifically offering around that figure.
